::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What the symbols mean

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:------:|:--------|
| $A$ | **Area**: the space inside the circle (square units) |
| $C$ | **Circumference**: the distance around the circle |
| $d$ | **Diameter**: the length of a segment across the circle through its center |
| $r$ | **Radius**: the distance from the center to any point on the circle |
| $\pi$ | **Pi**: $\pi = \frac{C}{d} \approx 3.14$, the same for every circle |
| $\theta$ | **Central angle**: an angle with its vertex at the center, in degrees |
| $^2$ | **Squared**: $r^2 = r \cdot r$ |
| $\frac{1}{2}$ | **One half** |
:::
